vault/enc/photos.note: garage's blocks: ente's and the media tier's ciphertext. Snapshots are cheap on immutable files and save you from rm -rf

vault/enc/backups.note: the database dumps: a different disk from the source, snapshotted, in this box's backup. ente's key hierarchy is a row in postgres; without it nobody can decrypt the blobs

vault/enc/media.note: all re-rippable, so no snapshots (one is the size of the library). lz4 early-aborts on what is already compressed

vault/enc/images.note: archives of old computers, encrypted on the client; written once, so no snapshots

vault/enc/forgejo.note: the forge: small, hot, irreplaceable, snapshotted, on the pool with what people made

tank/enc/games.note: members' game servers: each one's record, saves and guest disk

tank/enc/models.note: GGUF weights: incompressible, mlocked by llama-server so ARC keeps only metadata, and a snapshot of one costs its size
